product.title: Biblica. Atlasul Bibliei. O prezentare socială, istorică și culturală
product.description: Cel mai complex şi acualizat atlas al Bibliei editat până astăzi. Înfăţişează veridic povestiri dramatice, personaje charismatice şi locuri de semnificaţie istorică din Biblie. Structurat în opt secţiuni: Geografia şi istoria pământurilor biblice, Geneza şi epoca patriarhilor, Judecătorii, Regii, Profeţii şi cei drepţi, Cucerirea regatelor, Viaţa lui Iisus din Nazaret şi Răspândirea cuvântului. Cuprinde informaţii esenţiale despre topografia, geologia, clima acestei regiuni istorice.  Conţine 125 de hărţi originale ce prezintă sugestiv locuri, itinerarii, bătălii, regate şi imperii despre care se vorbeşte în Biblie, precum şi o listă extinsă a denumirilor geografice. Textul este însoţit de o secţiune de referinţe cu tabele informative, arbori genealogici, o bibliografie amplă pe acest subiect şi un glosar de termeni. Pune la dispoziţie cele mai recente descoperiri arheologice şi cercetări teologice. Alcătuit de o echipă internaţională de scriitori, cercetători universitari şi studioşi ai Bibliei. Ilustrat cu peste 650 de fotografii color spectaculoase, incluzând imagini panoramice ale unor peisaje, tablouri, desene, gravuri, miniaturi şi sculpturi aflate în cele mai importante galerii de artă, muzee şi colecţii.

# Biblica Atlasul Bibliei: A Comprehensive Social, Historical, and Cultural Guide

**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Non Fiction
**Price:** 379.99

The *Biblical Atlas* by Litera offers an unparalleled journey through the rich tapestry of biblical history. This is not just a book; it is arguably the most comprehensive and updated atlas dedicated to presenting the social, historical, and cultural context of the Bible to date. Whether you are a student, scholar, or deeply curious reader, this work provides essential geographical and narrative insights into the stories that shaped civilizations.

## Unpacking Biblical Geography and History

This definitive volume is meticulously structured to guide readers through the entire sweep of biblical times and places. The content is organized into eight distinct sections, ensuring a logical progression from ancient origins to the spread of early Christianity:

*   **Geography and History:** Covering the lands of the Bible in detail.
*   **Genesis and the Age of the Patriarchs:** Tracing the beginnings of humanity and key ancestral figures.
*   **The Judges.**
*   **The Kings.**
*   **Prophets and Righteous Men.**
*   **Conquest of Kingdoms.**
*   **The Life of Jesus in Nazareth.**
*   **The Spread of the Word (of God).**

## Key Features for Scholars and Enthusiasts

What sets this Biblical Atlas apart is its incredible depth, combining rigorous academic research with stunning visual presentation. The book features:

*   **125 Original Maps:** These maps are highly suggestive, illustrating key locations, historical itineraries, major battles, kingdoms, and empires mentioned throughout the Bible.
*   **Essential Reference Material:** Includes an extensive list of geographical names, a dedicated section of reference tables, detailed family trees (genealogies), and a comprehensive bibliography on the subject matter.
*   **Academic Rigor:** The text is supported by a glossary of terms and presents the most recent archaeological findings and theological research available.
*   **Stunning Visual Illustrations:** With over 650 spectacular full-color photographs, the book enriches your reading experience. These images include panoramic landscapes, renowned paintings, drawings, engravings, and miniatures sourced from the world's most important art galleries, museums, and collections.

The *Biblical Atlas* was compiled by an international team comprising writers, university researchers, and dedicated Bible scholars, guaranteeing both scholarly accuracy and narrative richness.

This volume is distinguished by its scopeâit combines detailed social, historical, and cultural analysis with an unprecedented number of original maps and cross-referenced academic materials, making it a true all-in-one resource.

While highly scholarly, the book is written to be accessible. Its structured approach and visual aids make complex biblical history engaging and digestible for enthusiasts of all levels.
